title: M5 Role-or-Follow Badge Component Fragment
description: Component fragment for the reusable M5 role-or-follow badge rendered inside the presence avatar stack and across collaboration strips, shared debug panes, shared terminals, and review / session headers. The badge always states the collaboration role and the follow state in text (role_label and follow_label are mandatory) so no presence truth is avatar-only, and it optionally marks the presenter, the control holder, and the local user. This fragment is governed by the packet schema schemas/ui/m5-presence-avatar-stack.schema.json.

participant_repr.description: Opaque, export-safe participant identity the badge annotates.

role.description: The collaboration role, reused from the frozen runtime-boundary matrix.

follow_state.description: The follow state, reused from the frozen runtime-boundary matrix.

rendered_parts.description: The badge parts this instance renders; must include the mandatory role and follow labels.

accessibility_routes.description: Non-visual routes; the badge must be keyboard focusable and non-hover reachable so it never relies on avatar imagery or hover alone.
